_readme: Batch of 20 candidates; 4 (Netochka Nezvanova, The Eternal Husband, The Adolescent/A Raw Youth, The Prelude) were not found on gutenberg.org and are skipped rather than fabricated. Synopses/mentions sourced from actually fetched Gutenberg full texts.

books.title: Swann's Way
books.author: Marcel Proust
books.synopsis: A sleepless man's memory of a childhood bedtime kiss unfolds into a vast recollection of Combray, and of Swann's own tormented, jealous love for the courtesan Odette. The opening volume of In Search of Lost Time.

books.title: Within a Budding Grove
books.author: Marcel Proust
books.synopsis: The narrator's adolescent infatuations — with the actress Berma on stage, with the diplomat Norpois, and with a band of girls on the beach at Balbec, above all the elusive Albertine — teach him how desire outruns its objects.

books.title: The Guermantes Way
books.author: Marcel Proust
books.synopsis: Fascinated by the aristocratic Guermantes family, the narrator pursues an entrée into their salons even as his grandmother's health fails and his friend Saint-Loup's engagement collapses under the weight of high society's cruelty.

books.title: The House of the Dead
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.synopsis: A political prisoner recounts four years of Siberian penal servitude — the barracks, the floggings, the strange dignity and cruelty of his fellow convicts — in Dostoevsky's fictionalized account of his own imprisonment.

books.title: Poor Folk
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.synopsis: An aging copying clerk and a young seamstress, distant relations living across a St. Petersburg courtyard from each other, sustain a tender epistolary friendship that poverty and a wealthy suitor slowly pull apart.

books.title: The Torrents of Spring
books.author: Ivan Turgenev
books.synopsis: A young Russian traveling through Frankfurt falls suddenly for an Italian confectioner's sister and gets engaged, only to be seduced away from her by the magnetic, manipulative wife of an old schoolfriend.

books.title: The Diary of a Superfluous Man
books.author: Ivan Turgenev
books.synopsis: A dying provincial nobleman, looking back over a wasted life, records in his diary the one humiliating unrequited love that defined him as permanently unnecessary to the world.

books.title: A House of Gentlefolk
books.author: Ivan Turgenev
books.synopsis: Believing himself free after his estranged wife's death abroad, Lavretsky falls in love with the devout young Liza, only for his wife to reappear alive, forcing a quiet renunciation on them both.

books.title: Anna of the Five Towns
books.author: Arnold Bennett
books.synopsis: A miserly Staffordshire manufacturer's dutiful daughter comes into an unexpected fortune, but finds herself unable to break free of her father's control or choose between two very different suitors.

books.title: The Wheels of Chance
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.synopsis: A put-upon draper's assistant sets off on a cycling holiday and falls in with a young woman fleeing an unwanted engagement, in Wells's comic idyll of Bank Holiday England on two wheels.

books.title: The Sea Lady
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.synopsis: A mermaid comes ashore at an English seaside resort, is passed off as a shipwrecked lady, and quietly seduces an ambitious young politician away from his sensible fiancée and his entire mundane world.

books.title: In the Days of the Comet
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.synopsis: A jealous young man sets out to murder his rival, but a comet's strange green gas transforms the atmosphere overnight, dissolving greed and violence and ushering in a rational socialist utopia.

books.title: Lyrical Ballads
books.author: William Wordsworth and Samuel Taylor Coleridge
books.synopsis: The founding volume of English Romanticism, pairing Wordsworth's plain-spoken poems of rustic life with Coleridge's supernatural Rime of the Ancient Mariner.

books.title: Adonais
books.author: Percy Bysshe Shelley
books.synopsis: Shelley's elegy for the young poet John Keats, mourning his early death and consoling itself with the vision of Keats's spirit absorbed back into the eternal beauty of nature.

books.title: The Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam
books.author: Omar Khayyam (trans. Edward FitzGerald)
books.synopsis: A sequence of Persian quatrains counsels wine, transience, and pleasure against the certainty of death and the futility of theological certainty, in FitzGerald's free and enormously influential English rendering.

books.title: The Hunting of the Snark
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.synopsis: A crew of oddly named adventurers — a Baker, a Butcher, a Banker, a Beaver — sail off to hunt the elusive Snark, in Carroll's nonsense epic that ends on a suddenly dark note.
